method: Fixed-seed sample of station + public POI pairs, two per type per straight-line distance bin; sample POIs without checking graph connectivity. Bounds are a rectangle, not the Taipei administrative boundary. Local routing only; no online official route, current elevator maintenance, field verification, or citywide representativeness. Shared and estimated distances are routing output, not evidence of safe accessibility. Pedestrian metres include mapped footway, path, pedestrian, corridor and verified connectors; they do not certify that all segments are sidewalks.
